scope.summary: Operator-listed fixes. (a) storage::artifacts::resolve_workspace_root no longer falls back to the compile-time CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR; order is HANDSHAKE_WORKSPACE_ROOT -> nearest ancestor with .handshake/ -> nearest git checkout root -> hard error (disk-agnostic, CX-109B). (b) storage::artifacts::sha256_hex is the single crate helper; normalize_sha256_hex_ref / format_sha256_ref / sha256_refs_match handle the three spellings (bare, sha256:, sha256-, artifact://sha256/). The23-file sweep in0b17acad and eight Atelier consumers are integrated. String-typed variants remain intentionally preserved; frontend copies belong to MT065. (c) storage::artifacts::write_file_artifact_streaming + StreamingFileArtifactSpec + remove_file_artifact; POST /atelier/media-assets raw-body ingest with HANDSHAKE_MEDIA_INGEST_MAX_BYTES (default 4 GiB) enforced while streaming; blob -> verify -> row with compensating remove on row failure / dedup. (d) Loom JSON+base64 import: explicit decoded-size cap + empty-payload rejection; documented as not a bulk-binary path.
remaining_compile_time_root_users: capability_registry_workflow::repo_root_from_manifest_dir still used by dependency_policy/{mod.rs,cui_gate.rs,manifest_tripwires.rs} and bin/capability_registry_workflow.rs (repo-governance tooling paths, not the artifact tier) - recorded as debt, not changed here
